name: match-clock
description: M4 Phase 3b scenario (epic #163; timers): the match clock MATIN, a clock event beyond the lamp and cure clocks. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0); unmodified pinned sources, START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE, no RANDOM override and no seed search. The first sixteen commands are troll-combat's (the sword kills the troll at the third blow under this clock and seed), then `north` to the East-West Passage, `north` to the Deep Ravine, `down` to Reservoir South, `up` to the Deep Canyon, `east` to the Dam and `north` to the Dam Lobby. `take match` (the matchbook, ORAND 5 matches, 77dung.mud:2392); `light match` (MATCH-FUNCTION 77act1.mud:1925: ORAND 4, FLAMEBIT and OLIGHT? 1, <CLOCK-INT ,MATIN 2>: "One of the matches starts to burn."); `look`, whose clock tick fires MATIN ("The match has gone out."); `look`; `light match` and `wait` (WAIT stops at the tick that fires MATIN); `light match` and `turn off match` ("The match is out.", <CLOCK-INT ,MATIN 0>); `light match` (the last match) and `light match` ("I'm afraid that you have run out of matches.", while the burning one goes out); `inventory`, `score`. The Maintenance Room route (the dam puzzle and its leak clock MNTIN) is not taken: this runtime stops on entering it (PRSOBJ frontier, docs/evidence/M4/DAM-CLOCKS.md). Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference; see docs/evidence/M4/MATCH-CLOCK-REFERENCE.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
